Method of Attack: Phishing technique exploiting zero-point fonts in emails to insert hidden words or characters by setting font size to zero, rendering text invisible to humans but readable by NLP algorithms to evade security filters
Manipulating message previews in email clients like Microsoft Outlook by hiding bogus security scan messages at the start of phishing emails to create a false sense of legitimacy
Attack Vector: Phishing emails using zero-point font to hide malicious content
Indicators of Compromise: Emails displaying deceptive preview messages such as 'Scanned and secured by Isc®Advanced Threat protection (APT): 9/22/2023T6:42 AM' in the email list pane while showing different content in the preview pane
Use of zero font size text to hide malicious keywords and bogus antivirus scan messages
